card.title: Carry This with Me
card.instruction: Get someone to share a burden by framing participation as part of the relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take half Mum's care-home forms. Being her children can't mean I'm the paperwork child.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then sit beside me. I'll explain, and you can write.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All right. It asks for one main contact.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put yourself. I'll help with every answer, but Mum needs to know she can reach either of us.

mechanism: A asks a sibling to share care paperwork as part of both being Mum's children.
confusable: Unlike simply reallocating administrative work, A must make participation a relational obligation while offering support.
comparison: D77-a shares answering but assigns B main-contact responsibility; D77-b insists on shared decisions about a relationship's letters.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
